basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old software engineer living in Los Alamos, New Mexico. I moved here a couple of years ago for work and have been enjoying the small-town charm ever since. I have a deep passion for indie music, especially artists like Bill Callahan, and I often get into discussions about gun control and the intricacies of chainsaw maintenance. I love Mexican food, which is why I'm always checking if Rigobertos Taco Shop is open. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, around 6 PM to 11 PM. Currently single, I spend my weekends hiking and exploring the beautiful nature surrounding Los Alamos.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science from the University of New Mexico. My expertise is mainly in software development and technology, which I further honed through various projects and personal interests. I am also self-taught in music theory and have a strong interest in social issues like gun control.
